title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed AI Engineer 
 Job Type: Full-Time 

 Role Overview 
 JLL is rolling out AI agents directly into the business: automating workflows, supporting decision-making, and integrating with the systems that run them. You will own your assigned business area as a one-person engineering team. The Center of Excellence in our central AI team gives you the methodology, the platform, and the patterns; the business gives you the problems, the SMEs, and the appetite for change. Your job is to turn that into shipped agents and MCP integrations, then hand mature work off to platform and operations as it stabilizes. We expect engineers at this level to operate with AI tools as a primary part of their workflow. Your leverage comes from the hooks, skills, the workflows, and automations you install to ship safely to production. The leverage in this role is AI, not headcount. 

 What You'll Do 
 Build and ship agents for the business, in close partnership with business SMEs and operators. Stand up MCP servers and connectors: pre-production first, then through CDR into production. Bootstrap skills, integrations, and evals on top of JLLs AI platform (LLM gateway, shared RAG services, MCP toolchain). Run workshops with business teams, teach them to use Claude Code, and translate their workflows into agent skills. Hand mature systems off to platform and operations teams once they outgrow the bootstrap phase. Feed patterns, anti-patterns, and platform gaps back into the Center of Excellence so the next FDE moves faster. 

 Must Have Experience 
 Shipped production agents using Claude Agent SDK, MCP, or an equivalent stack. Production code in at least one of Python, Node, or .NET, with comfort moving across the others. Worked with diverse data stores: relational, NoSQL, object/blob, vector, and document. Operated end-to-end as a one-person team: design, ship, support, hand off. 

 Traits 
 Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable in the room with non-engineers. Pragmatic judgment on when to ship, when to harden, and when to hand off. Systems thinking with a focus on failure modes; AI writes most of the code, you own it. Comfort with tasking and ability to run multiple agents in parallel as part of daily workflow. 

 Why This Role 
 JLL. A Fortune 200 company and a global leader in commercial real estate, with the stability of a $20B+ business and the resources to invest seriously in AI. The team. You sit at the seam of the business, product, and engineering, with a direct line into JLLs central AI platform via the Center of Excellence. The work is visible from business leadership on down. The role. The highest-leverage seat in the company: you ship things real users feel within weeks, not quarters, and the systems you bootstrap become the agents thousands of JLL employees rely on every day. Location: Bengaluru, KA Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40

title: Sr Applied AI Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to join Rubriks Applied AI team, building production-grade, full-stack applications and APIs for our internal Business teams while embedding AI-agentified capabilities into these internal platforms. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end - from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface - and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows, or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on. The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1-2 years) building AI-agentified applications - not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI during technical evaluation. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Own features end to end - database schema, backend services, APIs, and frontend (React/Next.js) user interface - operating as an owner rather than a ticket-taker. Build full-stack web applications: responsive, production-grade frontends using React/Next.js, backed by well-designed REST APIs and backend services. Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces. Build and productionize AI-agentified features - agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling - grounded in 1-2 years of hands-on experience with these systems. Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers. Apply reliability engineering practices - observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews - to keep production systems healthy. Design and optimize relational database schemas, including joins, indexing, and query performance tuning. Build clean, well-tested, production-grade frontend and backend code that others can read, test, and extend. Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked. Collaborate openly with internal Business stakeholders, Product, QA, DevOps, and UX or designer teams; avoid working in silos. 

 Required Qualifications 
 Education Experience Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack development (flexible based on demonstrated strength in technical evaluation). 1-2 years of hands-on experience building, integrating, or operating AI-agentified applications (agentic workflows, tool-calling, RAG, or LLM-powered features) in production. Demonstrated experience owning systems designed for scale and reliability, not just feature delivery. 

 Technical Skills - Applied AI 
 1-2 years of hands-on experience building AI-agentified applications, including agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, ADK, or equivalent), tool/function-calling for LLMs. Practical understanding of AI-specific considerations: latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails when exposing systems for AI consumption. Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or similar). 

 Technical Skills - Full Stack 
 Frontend: Strong JavaScript fundamentals; hands-on experience with React and Next.js for building modern, production-grade web applications (hooks, state management, component architecture, routing/SSR). Backend: Proficient in Python, writing production-grade code; hands-on experience with FastAPI or Flask (or equivalent frameworks) for building REST APIs. Database: Experience with relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB or equivalent); solid understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization. 

 Technical Skills - Distributed Systems Reliability 
 Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts: service decomposition, consistency models, caching, queuing/messaging, and failure handling. Reliability engineering fundamentals: observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, error budgets, and operational runbooks. Ability to reason about system design trade-offs and build scalable, resilient solutions under ambiguity. 

 Soft Skills 
 Proactive communication - shares updates without being asked and flags blockers early. Asks the right questions - clarifies requirements upfront before jumping into implementation. Ownership mindset - treats the project as their own rather than just completing tickets. Transparency - speaks up when something is unclear instead of making assumptions. Strong analytical mindset to break down complex or ambiguous problems. 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with agentic frameworks (ADK, LangGraph, or similar) beyond individual projects - production deployment experience preferred. Familiarity with API documentation standards (Swagger/OpenAPI). Basic DevOps awareness (Docker, CI/CD) and Git/version-control best practices. Testing experience across unit and integration levels. Experience with modern web app tooling - component libraries (Tailwind, MUI) and state management (Redux, Zustand). Exposure to cloud-native development (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containers and infrastructure as code.

title: Canada- Model validation RFP
description:
The Model Risk Management (MRM) provides oversight for the MRM Framework, which consists of the policy, processes, and procedures. The Quant Analyst - Model Risk Management (MRM) will be responsible for conducting independent model validations for the assigned models to ensure models align with business objectives and design objectives. Verify that models are performing as expected, identify potential limitations, which includes assessing potential impact. Perform annual reviews and review the on-going monitoring reports to ensure that the models are performing as intended. Key Responsibilities Comprehensive Model Validation: Conduct thorough and comprehensive validations of various model components, ensuring that they are accurate, reliable, and aligned with the intended business objectives and regulatory requirements. This includes but is not limited to: Model Inputs Analysis: Apply data analysis techniques to assess the quality, integrity, and appropriateness of data used in the models. Examine data extraction, cleaning, transformation processes, and evaluate data-related assumptions and limitations. Model Conceptual Evaluation: Scrutinize the model design and construction, verifying the suitability of the modeling framework and theory for the intended use. Review model segmentation, variable selection, model testing procedures, and evaluation model assumptions, limitations, and risks. Model Code Review and Replication: Review model code to ensure correctness, accuracy, and absence of material errors. Collaborate with model developers to address any identified issues. Outcomes Analysis: Assess both in-sample and out-of-sample back test results; evaluate sensitivity and scenario testing, stress testing, benchmark model development, and quantitative and business performance metrics. Challenger Model Development (if required) Risk Identification and Mitigation: Provide effective challenges and identify potential model risks. Recommend appropriate mitigation measures and enhancements to improve model quality and compliance with regulatory standards. Ongoing Monitoring and Outcome Analysis: Assess the mechanisms for ongoing model performance monitoring, issue identification, and risk management to ensure effective oversight, policy compliance. Ensure that the model remains reliable, relevant, and compliant throughout its lifecycle, this includes review risk mitigation measures, compensating controls, and risk acceptances. Documentation and Reporting: Produce high-quality, comprehensive validation reports that clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and potential risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ensure that validation documentation adheres to internal standards and regulatory requirements (SR11-7). Review and upgradation of MRM policies and Procedures annually, with new trends Audit and Regulatory Review Support: Assist in gathering and providing materials requested by internal audit and regulators, drafting responses to questions, and defending validations in exams. Continuous Learning and Improvement: Stay up to date with emerging trends and best practices in model validation and regulatory requirements. Contribute to the enhancement of the model validation framework by suggesting process improvements and implementing industry-leading methodologies. Develop and maintain model governance documentation and performance monitoring, including periodically presenting results to MRM stakeholders. Interact with all key stakeholders including model users, model owners, vendors, Model Risk Governance, and other Validators throughout the model lifecycle including validation, ongoing performance evaluation. Build relationships across model owners, data scientists, Model Risk Management, Audit, and third-party vendors. Use subject matter expertise and analytics to proactively identify and address gaps and identify emerging risks. Contribute towards remediation efforts for model-related issues identified through exams, audits, and model validations.

Team Leadership • Lead, mentor, and guide a team of 3-5 Power BI developers. • Provide technical oversight, code reviews, and troubleshooting support. • Allocate work, manage priorities, and remove delivery blockers. • Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and high-quality delivery. GOOD TO HAVE: • Financial Services domain experience. • Azure Data Platform knowledge. • Exposure to Python, SQL performance tuning, or advanced analytics. • Experience establishing Power BI governance frameworks and best practices. • Understanding of Responsible AI and Copilot governance. KEY TRAITS: • Client-facing and consultative mindset. • Ability to anticipate business needs and propose solutions proactively. • Strong ownership and leadership qualities. • Ability to think beyond development and drive reporting strategy, look-and-feel, and adoption. The role covers both generative AI (grounded conversational assistants using retrieval-augmented generation) and classical machine learning (forecasting, risk scoring, anomaly detection and root cause analysis), delivered as secure, scalable services on AWS.

The role suits an engineer who has shipped AI features to real users and cares as much about accuracy, citation and verification as about model capability.

 Build and maintain an LLM evaluation harness covering relevance, groundedness, citation accuracy, latency and regression testing 
 Develop forecasting, risk scoring and anomaly detection models on high-volume time-series and tabular data 
 Support AI-assisted root cause analysis: feature attribution, probability ranking of contributing causes and evidence summarisation 
 Expose AI/ML capabilities as secure REST APIs (Python FastAPI) deployed as containers on Kubernetes (EKS) 
 Integrate LLMs through private endpoints (e.g. AWS Bedrock / VPC endpoints) so data does not leave the controlled network 
 Enforce role-based access and data scope in retrieval, prompts and conversation state 
 Implement guardrails, graceful degradation, prompt/version management and audit logging 
 Set up monitoring and observability for model and assistant performance; use production logs to drive continuous evaluation 
 Work with data engineers on feature and predictive datasets, and with front-end and backend engineers on API contracts 
 Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, estimation and sprint delivery

The client is migrating SIEM capability from IBM QRadar to Elastic Security Stack and needs experienced engineers to support data-source onboarding, Elastic ingestion, ECS normalization, and detection logic development . 
 Role Summary The Senior SIEM Engineer will be responsible for onboarding and operationalizing prioritized security telemetry into Elastic Security , including creation and maintenance of data streams, ingest pipelines, index templates, field mappings, ECS normalization, and detection rules . The role requires strong hands-on experience in Elastic SIEM engineering, security log ingestion, parsing, detection engineering, and working with SOC/security monitoring teams. 
 Key Responsibilities Assess security log sources for onboarding readiness, including connectivity, log format, volume, collection method, parsing needs, data quality, field availability, and detection suitability. Design, configure, test, and maintain Elastic data streams , index templates, component templates, mappings, naming conventions, lifecycle policies, and retention settings. Develop and maintain Elastic ingest pipelines to parse, enrich, transform, and normalize security events. Map source fields to Elastic Common Schema (ECS) or approved security data models. Validate end-to-end telemetry ingestion into Elastic, including timestamp accuracy, parsing success, field extraction, mapping conflicts, duplicate events, data loss, and pipeline failures. Design, develop, test, tune, and deploy detection rules and security use cases in Elastic Security . Build detection logic using KQL, EQL, ES|QL, threshold rules, correlation logic, exceptions, risk scoring, and rule metadata . Map detections to relevant MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and sub-techniques . Document detection logic, test evidence, tuning decisions, false-positive considerations, known limitations, and production-readiness recommendations. Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, ECS mapping, indexing, alerting, detection, and performance issues across Elasticsearch and Kibana. Partner with SIEM Engineering, SOC, Threat Intelligence, application owners, source-system owners, and third-party teams such as Cribl. Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, implementation evidence, deployment records, risks, dependencies, and operational handover artifacts. Provide regular status updates on progress, blockers, risks, dependencies, and decisions required. 
 Required Skills and Experience 7+ years in cybersecurity / SIEM engineering , with at least 3+ years of hands-on Elastic Security / Elasticsearch / Kibana experience preferred. Strong hands-on experience as a SIEM Engineer / Detection Engineer / Security Data Engineer . Practical experience with Elastic Security / Elastic SIEM / Elasticsearch / Kibana . Experience creating and maintaining data streams, ingest pipelines, mappings, index templates, and lifecycle configurations . Strong knowledge of security log ingestion, parsing, enrichment, transformation, and normalization . Experience with Elastic Common Schema (ECS) mapping and data-model alignment. Hands-on experience writing detection rules using KQL, EQL, ES|QL , threshold logic, and correlation logic. Good understanding of SOC operations, alert triage, incident detection, and security monitoring use cases . Experience mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK . Ability to troubleshoot log ingestion, parsing, indexing, pipeline, and alerting issues. Strong documentation skills, including runbooks, design notes, validation evidence, and operational handover documents. Ability to work independently with multiple technical stakeholders and source-system owners. 
 Good to Have Experience with IBM QRadar to Elastic migration . Experience with Cribl for log routing, transformation, and enrichment. Experience with cloud, endpoint, identity, network, firewall, application, and infrastructure log sources. Familiarity with change-management and production deployment processes in enterprise environments. Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments. 
 Tools / Technologies Elastic Security Elasticsearch Kibana Elastic Ingest Pipelines Elastic Common Schema KQL / EQL / ES|QL MITRE ATT&CK Cribl IBM QRadar Jira / Confluence or similar tracking and documentation tools

title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation
description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team s transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. What you ll be doing: Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. What we need to see: Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team s traditional capacity. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.
